name: Nippon Sharyo, Ltd.
summary: Nippon Sharyo, Ltd. engages in the railway rolling stock, construction machinery, transportation equipment and steel structures, engineering, and other businesses in Japan, the United States, Asia, and internationally. The company offers electric trains, diesel railcars, hybrid vehicles, and passenger cars; and bullet, intercity and express, suburban and commuter, and exported train, as well as metro and subway, AGT, LRV, and monorail.
